preconditions.expression: all(line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip())
preconditions.description: All input lines are non-empty strings.
The first line of input is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 50) representing the number of test cases.
Each of the 12 lines per test case follows the format 'HomeTeamName HomeTeamGoals vs. AwayTeamGoals AwayTeamName'.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 100 and 0 <= int(line.split()[3]) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: HomeTeamGoals and AwayTeamGoals are integers between 0 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(team_name) <= 10 and team_name.islower() and team_name.isalpha() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for team_name in [line.split()[0], line.split()[4]])
preconditions.description: Team names are lowercase English letters with length ≤ 10.

postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a single line with two space-separated team names: the top-ranked team and the second top-ranked team, with no ties for these positions.

postconditions.expression: all(top_team in teams and second_team in teams for top_team, second_team in [line.strip().split() for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: The output team names are valid team names from the input matches.

postconditions.expression: all(points[top_team] > points[second_team] or (points[top_team] == points[second_team] and goal_diff[top_team] > goal_diff[second_team]) for top_team, second_team in [line.strip().split() for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: The top-ranked team has strictly more points than the second-ranked team, or if points are equal, a strictly higher goal difference. Here, `points` and `goal_diff` are computed as per the UEFA Champions League rules from the input matches.
